commands.name: CreateAndStoreJWTTokenFromCertificate
commands.description: Generates a JWT (JSON Web Token) using a certificate and stores it in Automation Pilot for secure authentication with SharePoint.

privateKey.description: The private key used for signing the JWT, base64 encoded.  Keep this secure.

autopiCatalog.description: The Automation Pilot catalog where the JWT will be stored.

certificatePem.description: The certificate in PEM format, used to generate the JWT. Base64 encoded.

clientId.description: The Client ID (Application ID) of the Azure AD application.

autopiUsername.description: The username of the Automation Pilot service account.

tenantId.description: The Tenant ID of the Azure AD instance.

autopiPassword.description: The password of the Automation Pilot service account.  Keep this secure.

autopiInputName.description: The name of the Automation Pilot input entity where the JWT will be stored.

commands.name: CreateCalendarListItem
commands.description: Creates a list item in a SharePoint list.

listTitle.description: The title of the SharePoint list.

baseUrl.description: The base URL of the SharePoint site (e.g., https://sap.sharepoint.com).

clientId.description: The Client ID (Application ID) of the Azure AD application.

itemTitle.description: The title for the list item that will be created.

tenantId.description: The Tenant ID of the Azure AD instance.

itemEnd.description: The end time of the event e.g. 6/11/2025 00:00. The format is month/day/year hh:mm.
